instruction: Create Loki config for local storage
output:
cat > /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
auth_enabled: false
server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_port: 9095
common:
  path_prefix: /var/lib/loki
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory
schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2020-10-24
      store: boltdb-shipper
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v11
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h
storage_config:
  boltdb_shipper:
    active_index_directory: /var/lib/loki/index
    cache_location: /var/lib/loki/cache
  filesystem:
    directory: /var/lib/loki/chunks
limits_config:
  reject_old_samples: true
  reject_old_samples_max_age: 168h
EOF

instruction: Create Loki config for S3 storage
output:
cat > /etc/loki/s3-config.yml << 'EOF'
auth_enabled: false
server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
common:
  storage:
    s3:
      endpoint: s3.amazonaws.com
      region: us-east-1
      bucketnames: my-loki-bucket
      access_key_id: ${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      secret_access_key: ${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      s3forcepathstyle: true
  path_prefix: /var/lib/loki
schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2020-10-24
      store: boltdb-shipper
      object_store: s3
      schema: v11
EOF

instruction: Create Loki config for memberlist clustering
output:
cat > /etc/loki/cluster-config.yml << 'EOF'
ring:
  kvstore:
    store: memberlist
  replication_factor: 3
memberlist:
  join_members:
    - loki-1:7946
    - loki-2:7946
    - loki-3:7946
EOF

cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
auth_enabled: true
multi_tenant_mode: true
EOF

instruction: Set ingestion rate limits in Loki

output:
cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
compactor:
  working_directory: /var/lib/loki/compactor
  shared_store: filesystem
  retention_enabled: true
EOF

cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
table_manager:
  retention_deletes_enabled: true
  retention_period: 720h
EOF

cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
ruler:
  storage:
    type: local
    local:
      directory: /etc/loki/rules
  rule_path: /tmp/loki/rules
  alertmanager_url: http://alertmanager:9093
EOF

cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
query_range:
  split_queries_by_interval: 24h
  results_cache:
    cache:
      embedded_cache:
        enabled: true
        max_size_mb: 100
EOF
